# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent: cand_0002, champion val=0.600)

## Goal this iteration
Champion cand_0002 solves 30/50 solidly; ~20 fail. cand_0002's type/recalc/reuse contract
prose did NOT move 57232 / 50630 / 53367 / 55931 / 56637 / 56427 (verified against this
iteration's traces), so pure "clarify the type contract" prose has plateaued. This iteration
pivots the lever from *more type rules* to **STRUCTURE** (make the agent reconcile against all
three copies + close coverage holes) plus a few tightly-scoped **KNOWLEDGE** rules that target
the specific wrong reasoning seen in the traces. All edits are in `task_template.md`;
`prompt.md` is untouched (JOURNAL shows anti-fabrication prose there broke 50051).

Method: 4 parallel read-only diagnostic subagents read this iteration's `./trajectories/`
(verify-step overfit cluster; existing-summary-formula recount cluster; split/extract datetime
cluster; text-key match-miss cluster + the 73-45 / recalc infra check). Findings below. Edits
applied serially by me (surgical, single file).

## Ranked failure clusters (this iteration's traces)

### 1. STRUCTURE — passes previewed copy, fails hidden copies 2/3 (overfit-to-copy-1)
Highest leverage. Multiple tasks pass 1/3: the agent reads only copy 1's preview, infers a rule
that fits it, and never runs its logic against the pre-filled worked-example values that exist
in copies 2/3 on disk. cand_0002's verify step (c) only said "reproduce the worked example"
without forcing per-copy reconciliation.
- **Edit A** (verify sub-step c, rewritten): reproduce EVERY worked example on EVERY copy; if
  target/adjacent cells are pre-filled in ANY of the three on-disk copies, run the logic on each
  and confirm it reproduces that copy's values exactly; an interpretation fitting copy 1 but not
  2/3 is the WRONG rule — recompute, don't copy. Names "passes 1/3, fails the rest" as the top
  failure mode.
- Verify-the-fix: overfit tasks are exactly those that satisfy copy 1's preview but diverge on
  the hidden copies; forcing reconciliation against all on-disk copies is the only in-loop signal
  that catches the wrong rule before the final block ships.
- Blast radius: BOUNDED. The 30 passing tasks already reproduce all three copies (that is why
  they pass 3/3), so the stricter check changes nothing for them — it only adds work on tasks
  currently failing.

### 2. STRUCTURE — coverage holes ("" / None in a required cell)
- **Edit D** (verify sub-step d, new): no cell the instruction expects to hold a value may be
  left None/""; an outer IF(...,"") that can evaluate to "" is a bug → return the real value.
  Explicitly exempts cells the pattern leaves intentionally blank.
- Verify-the-fix: complements the existing "a formula that evaluates to '' lowers coverage" prose
  with a concrete verify-time check the agent must run.
- Blast radius: BOUNDED. Phrased to NOT fill intentionally-blank cells (325-44 F2, 55060), so
  passing tasks that legitimately leave cells empty are untouched.

### 3. KNOWLEDGE — hand-rolled Python recount diverges from the sheet's own formula
Tasks where an adjacent COUNTIF/COUNTIFS/SUMIFS/summary column already computes the statistic,
but the agent re-counts raw cells in Python; Python's string/number equality (case, spaces,
text-vs-number, wildcards) diverges from Excel's, so the recount ≠ reference.
- **Edit B1** (Reuse-the-answer-pattern block, appended bullet): if the workbook already computes
  the SAME statistic in adjacent/helper/summary cells, reference or replicate THAT formula rather
  than re-counting in Python; states WHY (Python vs Excel comparison semantics diverge).
- Verify-the-fix: directly addresses the traced miscount; grounded in the recalc contract we
  already rely on.
- Blast radius: BOUNDED. Fires only when a matching in-sheet summary formula exists; passing
  tasks with no such helper column are unaffected.

### 4. KNOWLEDGE — split/extract piece parsed into a datetime because an example cell holds one
On a split/extract, an example cell in the range already STORES a real datetime/number (not
merely a date number_format), so the agent parsed the extracted piece into a date/number. The
operation should dictate output type, not the example cell's stored type.
- **Edit C** (split/extract bullet, extended): extracted pieces stay str even when a pre-filled
  example cell holds a real datetime/number value — the operation dictates the output type.
- Verify-the-fix: closes the loophole in cand_0002's split/extract rule where "keep as str" could
  be overridden by a same-column datetime example cell.
- Blast radius: BOUNDED and scoped to split/extract; does NOT touch the CONVERT/STANDARDIZE rule
  (51958, a passer) or date-passers (110-2, 41297), which are whole-value conversions, not splits.

### 5. KNOWLEDGE — text-key match miss → invented #N/A instead of normalizing
55931: 8 songs emitted "#N/A" whose names differed from the key only by surrounding whitespace /
a non-breaking space / a curly apostrophe. The reference resolves them to real values.
- **Edit B2** (new bullet after the don't-invent-#N/A converse rule): when matching rows by a
  text key, normalize BOTH sides (trim incl. \xa0, collapse double spaces, unify curly/smart
  quotes+apostrophes to straight) before comparing; a miss after normalizing is NOT a licence to
  emit #N/A/"-"/blank — re-check the key extraction.
- Verify-the-fix: matches the traced failure exactly (cosmetic unicode/whitespace mismatch).
- Blast radius: BOUNDED. Fires only on a text-key match miss; passing lookup tasks match cleanly
  and normalizing an already-clean key is a no-op.

## Environment fault — HAND BACK, not prose-fixable
- **73-45**: recalc/infra fault (LibreOffice failed to recalc the written formula → graded
  blank). NOT a capability gap; no prompt edit can fix it, and it was broken by both cand_0001 and
  cand_0002 as collateral of unrelated type rules. cand_0003 adds NO rule that touches
  rich-text/formatting, so 73-45 should be unaffected here. Flagged for the harness owner.

## Deliberately SKIPPED (unrecoverable from visible data — would force overfitting/hardcoding)
- 5192 (contradictory worked examples across copies), 30709 (Excel locale DATEVALUE quirk in GT),
  56996 (RANDBETWEEN moving target — not deterministically gradeable), 325-44 / 450-9
  (under-determined; preview window too small to infer the expansion/label rule), 53367
  (value-logic, not type/recalc), 3911 (allocation pool quirk, fails its own preview copy).
  Prose cannot fix these without hardcoding the gold answer (forbidden).

## Building on prior RESULTS
- cand_0002 ACCEPTED (fixed {47741,51958,59259}): kept all of its contract prose verbatim as the
  base; this iteration only ADDS to it.
- cand_0001 REJECTED broke={50051,73-45}: did NOT re-add prompt.md anti-fabrication prose, and did
  NOT add any global "text → plain string" type rule. Both known regressions avoided.

## Constraints honored
- Edited ONLY task_template.md; prompt.md unchanged. No adapter/harness/scorer/env edits.
- All load-bearing placeholders present and unchanged: {instruction} {spreadsheet_path}
  {spreadsheet_content} {instruction_type} {answer_position} {output_path} {max_turns}.
- No task-specific id/value/date/answer hardcoded; every rule is a general condition.
- All 5 edits are additive/BOUNDED; no global decision/permission rule touched.
